methods_quotes.q: VE was estimated using logistic regression models
Regression models controlled for race, age, calendar time (week of enrollment), and enrollment site.
VE was calculated as (1 – adjusted odds ratio) x 100%; estimates with nonoverlapping 95% CIs were considered statistically significant.
Pearson’s chi-square tests were used to compare demographic and clinical characteristics among case- and control-patients and by vaccination status.
